Package org.webharvest.runtime.processors.plugins.db

Class DatabaseJNDIPlugin

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.runtime.processors.AbstractProcessor<WebHarvestPluginDef>
      • org.webharvest.runtime.processors.WebHarvestPlugin
        • org.webharvest.runtime.processors.plugins.db.AbstractDatabasePlugin
          • org.webharvest.runtime.processors.plugins.db.DatabaseJNDIPlugin
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Processor<WebHarvestPluginDef>
    @Autoscanned
@TargetNamespace("http://org.webharvest/schema/2.1/jndi")
@Definition(value="database",
            validAttributes="name")
public final class DatabaseJNDIPlugin
extends AbstractDatabasePlugin
    Web Harvest plugin supporting database operations within JNDI - enabled environment. Database connection is obtained from ConnectionFactory, thus, its implementation must be JNDI-aware. DatabaseJNDIPlugin allows for execution of database queries in the same way as the standard DatabasePlugin, but also allows for integration with some external connection pool (c3p0, dbcp and so forth).
